title: Hugging Face upload plan — Cloth BRDF dataset for NeurIPS 2026 D&B

neurips_2026_requirements.submission_deadline: Dataset must be hosted and reviewer-accessible at submission
neurips_2026_requirements.metadata: Croissant core + Responsible AI metadata, validated
neurips_2026_requirements.large_dataset_rule: Provide ≤4 GB sample subset (3.5 TB > 4 GB threshold)
neurips_2026_requirements.anonymity: Double-blind — use anon HF account at submission

hosting_decision.plan: Pro (10 TB public / 1 TB private + pay-as-you-go)
hosting_decision.visibility: public (HF doesn't credit private-preview for NeurIPS per spec)

tree.README.md: dataset card with YAML frontmatter + prose
tree.LICENSE: CC-BY-4.0 by default (decision pending — see license_options)
tree.sample/: ≤4 GB representative subset (NeurIPS rule). Single material with downsampled HDR (e.g. ~50 PNGs + npz subset).
tree.examples/: load_material.py, inspect_subset.ipynb (no in-repo dataset loader script — HF discourages)

tar_strategy.rationale: Raw PNG layout is 500*575=287,500 files, exceeds HF's 100k/repo cap. Tar-per-material drops to ~5k files.

A_BytesIO_RAM.notes: Best for current setup. With 1 TB host RAM, 4-8 workers fit easily.

B_dev_shm_staging.description: Stage tars in /dev/shm in batches (504 GB tmpfs free), run upload_large_folder, wipe, repeat
B_dev_shm_staging.notes: Keeps upload_large_folder's resumable machinery; more bookkeeping.

C_streaming_pipe.reason: HF/LFS/Xet pre-computes SHA256 — needs seekable buffer.

tar_strategy.recommended: A_BytesIO_RAM with custom uploader (per-material loop, done-log for resume)

if_running_on_8tb_hdd_directly.tar_to_tmpfs_per_material_seconds: 40-60 (HDD sequential read of 575 PNGs at 100-150 MB/s)

upload_strategy.primary_api: HfApi.upload_file with BytesIO (custom loop) OR upload_large_folder for staged trees

env_vars.HF_TOKEN: set from anon account write token

upload_strategy.auth: hf auth login (one-time) or HF_TOKEN env
upload_strategy.resume_strategy: Maintain done-log JSON: list of {material_id, file, sha256, uploaded_at}. Skip on restart.

wall_time_estimates_no_nfs.recommended_pre_run: Benchmark single material end-to-end before full run.

license_options.rationale: Modal choice across NeurIPS D&B (OpenIllumination, MVP-N, OmniObject3D). Permissive, max community uptake.

alternatives.CC-BY-NC-4.0: Use if concerned about commercial reuse of cloth captures (e.g. third-party fabric designs).
alternatives.other_custom: Use if specific clauses needed (SSS-GS pattern). Higher friction.
alternatives.CC0: Maximum permissive, less common at NeurIPS.

croissant_metadata.auto_core: HF generates from dataset card automatically

maintenance.adding_materials: Re-run upload pipeline; Xet skips already-uploaded chunks.
maintenance.patching_metadata: Edit JSONs locally → upload_file each. Inline (non-LFS), so no quota concern.
maintenance.history_squash: super_squash_history once before camera-ready if commit history > few thousand.

operational_constraints.do_not_modify_running_scripts: Per project rule — write build_hf_tree.py + upload_to_hf.py as new files, don't touch build_submission.py.
operational_constraints.if_uploading_from_8tb_hdd_local: No NFS concerns — single-head HDD limits parallel tar speed-up to ~1.5-2x

minimal_python_skeleton.create_repo: from huggingface_hub import create_repo; create_repo('anon/cloth-brdf-2026', repo_type='dataset', private=False)
minimal_python_skeleton.rename_repo: from huggingface_hub import move_repo; move_repo(from_id, to_id, repo_type='dataset')
minimal_python_skeleton.tag_release: from huggingface_hub import create_tag; create_tag(repo_id, tag='v1.0-neurips-submission', repo_type='dataset')
